outcome: the applicant was declared to be partially incapacitated
supporting_quote: In a judgment of 20 November 2000, the court declared the applicant to be partially incapacitated on the grounds that he had been suffering from simple schizophrenia since 1975

deciding_body: the Veliko Tarnovo Court of Appeal
supporting_quote: That judgment was upheld in a judgment of 12 April 2001 by the Veliko Tarnovo Court of Appeal ( Апелативен съд ) on an appeal by the applicant

outcome: the Municipal Council appointed Ms R.P. as the applicant’s guardian
supporting_quote: on 23 May 2002 the Municipal Council appointed Ms R.P., a council officer, as the applicant’s guardian until 31 December 2002.

outcome: the requirements for placement in a social care home were deemed to be fulfilled
supporting_quote: Social services drew up a welfare report on the applicant, noting on 23 July 2002 that he was suffering from schizophrenia... The requirements for placement in a social care home were therefore deemed to be fulfilled.

outcome: the Municipal Council decided to appoint the Director of the Pastra social care home as the applicant’s guardian
supporting_quote: In a letter dated 16 September 2005, she was informed that the Municipal Council had decided on 2 February 2005 to appoint the Director of the Pastra social care home as the applicant’s guardian.

outcome: the regional prosecutor refused to bring an action for restoration of the applicant’s legal capacity
supporting_quote: On 10 August 2005 the regional prosecutor refused to bring an action for restoration of the applicant’s legal capacity

outcome: the regional prosecutor’s refusal was upheld
supporting_quote: Despite those objections, the regional prosecutor’s refusal was upheld on 11 October 2005 by the appellate prosecutor

outcome: the mayor of Rila refused the request to bring a court action for release from partial guardianship
supporting_quote: In a letter of 16 September 2005, the mayor of Rila refused his request, stating that there was no basis for such an action

deciding_body: the Chief Public Prosecutor’s Office at the Supreme Court of Cassation
outcome: the regional prosecutor’s refusal was upheld
supporting_quote: and subsequently on 29 November 2005 by the Chief Public Prosecutor’s Office at the Supreme Court of Cassation.
The Dupnitsa District Court gave judgment on 10 March 2006... As to the merits, the court dismissed the application
